text:
nina: Quick follow-up from the KV eviction postmortem thread. We need to formalize ownership, recurrence, and tie specific incident patterns to concrete evals so we stop chasing the same regressions. Proposal: (1) regression families keyed to recurrence patterns, (2) prompt bank per failure mode, (3) scheduled soak + micro-chaos with measurement radiators. Thoughts?
darren: I like the pattern-keyed approach. I'll catalog the recurring fingerprints (prefix thrash, long-history trim, concurrent writes) and map each to a regression family. ETA: 7 days for initial mapping.
zoe: I'll build the prompt bank once Darren's patterns land. Plan: ~220 prompts with tags: pattern, sensitivity, seed, expected token-level diffs. Deliverable in 10 days.
ricky: I'll own the CI plumbing: presubmit tiny subset for PRs touching kv/cache/router, nightly sampled runs, and a weekly full sweep. Will add cost caps and a flag to disable blocking for infra flakes. ETA: 12 days.
hana: Ops will run the soak + micro-chaos. Need explicit pass/fail signals (fallback rate, 95p latency delta, KV miss multiplier) and a rollback checklist. Dry run next Wed.
nina: Good. Darren can you include recurrence detection logic in the catalogue? e.g., detect if same fingerprint appears 3x in 90 days -> escalate to higher-sensitivity prompt tagging and mandatory weekly sweeps.
darren: Yes  I'll add detection heuristics and suggested thresholds. Also will link historical incidents to the catalog entries so owners can see provenance.
zoe: Prompt bank will include model/quantization tags and a "repro steps" field so SREs can replay easily. Also plan to mark top-30 high-sensitivity prompts that gate weekly.
ricky: Presubmit matcher: paths globs: "src/serving/kv/**", "libs/kv_cache/**", "src/router/**". Small-run should be <2m. Nightly: small+med, Weekly: full matrix.
hana: Suggested soak pass criteria: 30m at 1.2x prod 99th, synthetic 10s spike, pass if fallback <0.5%, 95p latency increase <25%, KV miss multiplier <3.5x. We'll capture artifacts and traces.
nina: Ops-bot please create tasks and wire recurrence reminders: weekly regression grooming (owner: ricky), quarterly chaos execution (owner: hana), and pattern catalog maintenance (owner: darren). Link back to postmortem doc.
ops-bot: Tasks created: PF-9001 (pattern-catalog) owner: darren due: 2026-04-05; PF-9002 (eviction-prompt-bank) owner: zoe due: 2026-04-08; PF-9003 (ci-regression-plumbing) owner: ricky due: 2026-04-14; PF-9004 (soak-micro-chaos) owner: hana due: 2026-04-07. Recurrences added: weekly regression grooming (ricky), quarterly chaos run (hana). Links: https://tasks.internal/PF-9001 https://tasks.internal/PF-9002 https://tasks.internal/PF-9003 https://tasks.internal/PF-9004
darren: I'll post the initial fingerprint taxonomy in PF-9001 and tag related incidents.
zoe: Will upload prompt CSV + expected outputs to PF-9002 and @-mention ML reviewers.
ricky: I'll open PRs tomorrow with the presubmit matcher and a sampled CI matrix. Cost estimates included.
hana: Scheduling staging dry run Thu 2026-04-02 09:00 PT, invites to owners and ML reviewers sent.
nina: Final: tie top-30 high-sensitivity prompts to PR gating for KV-sensitive code paths and link regression diffs to incident tickets for faster TTR. Thanks all. We'll meet after the dry run to lock thresholds and recurrence cadence. :white_check_mark:
